# Sans

> > Sans provides advanced air and water purification systems designed to create healthier home environments through innovative filtration technology.

Sans specializes in residential air and water purification products featuring technologies like HEPA-13 filtration, UV-C light, reverse osmosis, and SmartPure systems. The company offers a range of products from portable mini units to countertop systems, along with replacement filters and bundle deals for comprehensive home purification.

## Key Topics

- HEPA-13 Filtration
- Reverse Osmosis
- UV-C Light Technology
- SmartPure
- Activated Carbon Filters
- Air Quality Index (AQI)
- Indoor Air Quality
- Water Filtration
- Self-Cleaning Water Bottle
- Bundle Deals
- Countertop Purification
- Portable Air Purifiers
- Home Health
- CARB Certified
- E. coli Removal
